title.en: Write Pleiades EQDSK from flux-grid contour state
title.zh: 从磁通网格状态写入 Pleiades EQDSK

summary: Recover the source contour writer with explicit grid, contour-selection and parametric-arclength contracts.

identity.relation: Grid/flux/current state -> Pleiades extended EQDSK with selected limiter/vessel contours
identity.direction: R,Z,psi,plasma-current state to serialized dialect record
identity.definition: Nearest grid node to (0.6,0) chooses psi_lim; vessel level is 1.02 psi_lim; longest contour component at each level is selected; source hint vertices near (0.05,0.5) and (0.05,-0.5) choose the arc. This successor resamples by cumulative polyline arclength instead of fitting R(Z), retaining adjacency and orientation.
identity.model: Pleiades legacy extended dialect and source contour choices; no EFIT/COCOS or physical boundary claim. The five serialized profile blocks are fixed zero arrays of source length 101; this writer does not infer pressure, safety-factor, or other physical profiles.
identity.geometry: Finite separable rectangular zero-origin R,Z grid and 2-D flux field.
identity.coordinates: R,Z caller coordinates; serialized coordinate pairs and psi use source units.
identity.boundary: Exactly 100 limiter and 100 vessel coordinate pairs; source-selected contour may fail when levels are absent/degenerate.
assumptions: R starts at zero and Z is centred at zero
Current array is finite and same shape; Ip is its sum
The five profile blocks remain the source-required zeros (101 values each); their zeros carry no inferred physical interpretation
Contour approximation is polyline arclength, not a physical boundary solver.

inputs.name: psi
inputs.constraints: Distinct contour levels at chosen nodes

inputs.name: filename
inputs.constraints: Destination is opened only after all checks/contour extraction

outputs.name: file
outputs.description: Pleiades extended EQDSK text with 100 limiter/vessel pairs

supported: Destination preservation on invalid origin/null contours

failure_semantics.invalid_input: EQDSKFormatError before destination write for shape, origin, nonfinite, absent or degenerate contour conditions.
failure_semantics.runtime_failure: Matplotlib contour and filesystem exceptions are wrapped/propagated with no partial file claim.
failure_semantics.nonconvergence: Direct contour extraction; no iterative convergence contract.
failure_semantics.partial_results: No output file is committed until contour data validates.

provenance.lineage_summary: Recovered source io.py raw write_eqdsk route after source failures on vertical/ellipse/negative cases. Parametric arclength replaces invalid single-valued R(Z) spline while preserving source level, component, hint and count choices.
provenance.license_status: MIT source retained; human and release approval pending.

python.signature: write_pleiades_eqdsk_legacy_raw(R, Z, psi, plas_currents, filename: 'str | Path', title: 'str') -> 'None'

example.description: Write a representable analytic flux grid.
example.code:
import numpy as np
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
from pathlib import Path
from scirel.io.eqdsk import write_pleiades_eqdsk_legacy_raw
R,Z=np.meshgrid(np.linspace(0,2,21),np.linspace(-1,1,21))
psi=(R-1)**2+Z**2
with TemporaryDirectory() as td: write_pleiades_eqdsk_legacy_raw(R,Z,psi,np.ones_like(R),Path(td)/"x.eqdsk","demo")
example.expected: A parseable extended EQDSK with source-selected contour records.

scope: Source positive/negative/ellipse failure regressions and corrected contour output
Independent lexical, sign, count and no-silent-loss checks
verification.evidence_ceiling: Bounded serialization and contour geometry; no physical boundary or standard-EFIT claim.
known_limitations: Selection hints can fail when the requested level has no contour
Polyline contour accuracy depends on source grid resolution
